name: Link Automator Pro
author: Calogero1975

sections.description:
Stop wasting time manually adding links to every single post!

Link Automator Pro transforms your content strategy by automatically converting specified keywords into links throughout your website. Whether you’re running affiliate campaigns, building internal link structures, or promoting your products, this plugin saves you countless hours of manual work.

🚀 Real-World Use Cases:

💰 Affiliate Marketing Made Easy
* Set “iPhone 15” to automatically link to your Amazon affiliate URL across all posts
* Add “web hosting” links to your hosting affiliate program
* Convert product mentions into commission-earning links without touching old content

📈 SEO & Internal Linking
* Automatically link “contact us” to your contact page sitewide
* Build topic clusters by linking related keywords to pillar pages
* Improve your site’s link equity distribution effortlessly

🛍️ E-commerce & Product Promotion
* Link product names to your store pages automatically
* Promote seasonal offers by linking relevant keywords
* Drive traffic to landing pages without manual updates

📚 Content & Resource Linking
* Link “download guide” to your lead magnets
* Connect service mentions to your pricing pages
* Reference blog posts automatically through keyword mentions

⏱️ Save Massive Time:
Instead of manually editing hundreds of posts to add the same links, set it once and let the plugin work automatically. Perfect for:
– Bloggers with extensive archives
– Affiliate marketers managing multiple campaigns
– Agencies handling client websites
– E-commerce sites with large product catalogs

🛡️ Smart & Safe:
* Never double-links (won’t link text that’s already linked)
* Respects your content structure
* Limits replacements per post to avoid over-optimization
* Case-sensitive and whole-word matching options

✨ Key Features:
* One-Click Setup: Add keywords and URLs in seconds
* Bulk Management: Handle hundreds of keywords efficiently
* Priority System: Control which links take precedence
* Post Type Control: Choose which content types to process
* Link Attributes: Add nofollow, target=”_blank” automatically
* Safe Processing: Excludes existing links and preserves content structure
* Performance Optimized: Lightweight and fast processing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/link-automator-pro/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings → Link Automator Pro screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I set up Amazon affiliate links?

Simply add your product keywords (like “iPhone 15”, “MacBook Pro”) and paste your Amazon affiliate URLs. The plugin will automatically convert these mentions across all your posts into affiliate links.

Will this hurt my SEO by over-linking?

No! You can set limits on replacements per post (we recommend 3-5 max). The plugin also ensures it never links the same keyword twice in one post and won’t create links within existing links.

Can I use this for internal linking?

Absolutely! This is perfect for internal SEO. Link keywords like “contact us”, “services”, or topic-related terms to relevant pages on your site to boost your internal link structure.

Does it work with existing content?

Yes! Once you add keywords, they’ll automatically start working on all your existing posts and pages, not just new content.

Can I make links open in new tabs?

Yes, there’s a setting to automatically add target=”_blank” to all generated links, perfect for affiliate links or external references.

Will it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is highly optimized and only processes content when it’s being displayed. It won’t affect your site’s loading speed.

Can I add nofollow to affiliate links?

Yes! There’s an option to automatically add rel=”nofollow” to all generated links, which is recommended for affiliate links.

What if I want to stop linking a keyword temporarily?

You can deactivate individual keywords without deleting them, then reactivate later when needed.

Does it work with WooCommerce products?

Yes! You can set it to work with any post type, including WooCommerce products, custom post types, and more.
